title: Introduction to AI-Powered Smart Mushroom Farming
description: Learn the fundamentals of smart mushroom farming and how artificial intelligence and IoT technologies improve productivity, sustainability, and decision-making in mushroom cultivation.
content: Lesson Overview: This lesson introduces learners to the concept of AI-powered smart mushroom farming. Participants will explore the mushroom cultivation lifecycle, including substrate preparation, inoculation, incubation, fruiting, harvesting, and post-harvest handling. The lesson explains how environmental factors such as temperature, humidity, carbon dioxide, and light affect mushroom growth, and demonstrates how IoT sensors and AI analytics can monitor these conditions in real time. Learners will also discover how predictive analytics can detect potential issues early, optimize growing conditions, reduce contamination risks, and improve farm productivity. By the end of the lesson, participants will understand the role of digital technologies in modern agriculture and how the BRIDGE-AI Kenya project is supporting sustainable mushroom farming through innovation and capacity building.
subtext: Discover how AI and IoT technologies are transforming mushroom farming through smart monitoring and data-driven decision-making.
